reviews.author: kazel
reviews.text:
Originally, I was obsessed with the classic sandwiches and crouties here, so I always ordered the same menu whenever I had brunch or dessert, but this time I tried the new chestnut tirasu!

Chestnut tiramisu, a visual that excites you from the first impression! 🌰✨

First of all, when the chestnut tiramisu came out, I was impressed by its appearance. The cream and tiramisu base, which were moderately divided into layers, were beautifully topped with soft chestnut powder. There was a little bit of powder sprinkled on top and small pieces of chestnuts on top, so just looking at it made me feel good. It looked perfect for taking pictures, so I was busy taking pictures for a while. 📸

A combination of deliciously soft cream and subtle chestnut scent 😋

When I took my first bite, the subtle scent of chestnuts spread along with the soft cream, and the soft and nutty taste was exquisite. Regular tiramisu has a strong coffee scent and has a slightly bitter taste, but chestnut tiramisu is mainly composed of soft and sweet chestnut flavor, so it feels more cozy.

The cream itself wasn't too sweet, and each bite was moist and soft, so I was really satisfied. I could also taste a hint of the espresso flavor, which is the basis of tiramisu, and the balance with the sweetness was really good.

Chestnut tiramisu, perfect as a dessert after brunch! ☕

It goes really well with brunch menu items like sandwiches and crouties, which are popular here. I had this chestnut tiramisu as dessert after brunch, and it felt like the perfect dessert to end a hearty meal. It was a special menu that allowed you to fully enjoy the flavor of the chestnuts, perfect for fall and winter, allowing you to fully enjoy the season.

Recommended points 💡

Anyone can enjoy it with soft cream and subtle chestnut flavor.

Thanks to its not-too-sweet and moist texture, it's perfect as a dessert after brunch.

It's a seasonal dessert, so I recommend trying it when you visit in the fall/winter!

Overall review

I was obsessed with Entrepreneur's sandwiches and croquettes, but now chestnut tiramisu has been added to my dessert list. 😍 Perhaps because it is a dessert filled with the subtle and cozy taste of chestnuts, it felt like it went well with the warm atmosphere of the cafe.

reviews.author: ethan ghymn
reviews.text:
I think I also came across this store through an advertisement on Instagram, but it wasn't registered on Manpple, so I registered it and saved it in I Want to Go. Today, when I came to Sushi Sasanoha to buy take-out sushi, I looked to see if there was another store nearby that I had saved in I Want to Go, and there was Varenna Espresso Bar, so I grabbed the take-out sushi and headed to the store.

The store was not located in a small building in the neighborhood like Lisar Coffee, which is famous for its espresso bars, but was located on the first floor of a large building on the main street.

As you enter the store, the ceiling is quite high and the store is small, but it doesn't feel stuffy.

When I looked at the menu, I saw that the prices for standing at the bar were different from those for eating while sitting at a table, so it felt like a foreign system to differentiate them that way. But when I looked at the prices, they were different from the much better prices of Italian espresso bars that I had seen on YouTube. It felt like they didn't bring in the good stuff and brought in the bad stuff, which made me smile bitterly.

Since I was going to just taste it and then go home and eat take-out sushi, I decided to eat it at the bar. Normally, I would have ordered a basic espresso, but I was wondering if there were any other popular menu items in this restaurant, so I inquired and was informed of Confanya, Café Chocolato, and Café Mandole in the second row.

I like coffee with acidity, so I asked if I could choose coffee beans with acidity, and he said there was no acidity. When you asked for acidity, you were talking about Cafe Romano, which comes with lemon. But I wanted the acidity of the coffee itself, not the acidity of lemon, so I asked for the con panna, which is topped with dry cream, among the popular menu items.

It was ready in no time, but I was instructed to eat it as is without mixing the whipped cream on top, so I guess the contrast between the subtle sweetness of the whipped cream and the bitterness of the coffee gave it a good Einspänner feel.

As you said, I tasted it without mixing in the whipped cream. The whipped cream was cold and quite firm, and had a nice subtle sweetness, almost like vanilla ice cream. It contrasted well with the bitter and savory espresso, so it was good.

I quickly emptied it with one shot, drank the water prepared on one side of the store, rinsed my mouth, and went out.

Overall, it was a new espresso bar, so I stopped by on the way nearby and the taste felt a little better than Lisar Coffee, but the price was a bit more expensive and there was a difference in price between eating while standing at the bar and sitting at a table.

Still, I think I'll stop by again if I want to drink espresso when I'm nearby.

reviews.author: JeongHyoJin
reviews.text:
I learned about Shinsegae Oden through a friend who lives in Songpa-gu.
I enjoyed it so much that I visited this restaurant three or four more times.

First of all, it is a bit far from Songnidan-gil or Bangi-dong, which are crowded with people.
So, it's nice that there aren't many people in the neighborhood, but this Shinsegae Oden is always crowded, so you often have to wait.

On my first visit, I had oden and sushi, and the oden soup was so delicious that the restaurant has oden in its name.
In particular, it is quite fun to order and eat various types of oden.
And the sushi is very fresh and delicious.
In the past, when I ordered a highball, they would make a bourbon highball using Maker's Mark, but I don't know what whiskey they use these days.

On a later visit, I ordered futomaki and crab intestine pasta, as well as other menu items, and they were very delicious.
Personally, I don't like shiso leaves, but the shiso leaves and cucumbers used in futomaki are very attractive.

If you visit on a Friday evening, you might expect a line of visitors, but weekday evenings are quite quiet.
There are still many menu items that interest me, so I hope to visit often in the future.
I had a good time.

I ordered pasta and a side dish, and the plating was neat and the overall taste was well balanced, so it was great to enjoy with wine. I was particularly impressed by the variety of wines available, making it easy to choose one to suit your taste.

The staff was kind enough to explain the menu and responded comfortably, so I left the meal in a good mood.

If you want to enjoy the atmosphere, taste, and service of Songnidan-gil, this is a place worth visiting again 🍷
